purpose: Verify permitted outcome of BR-GYM-001 when coordinator, co-coordinator, and replacement leaders reference valid students.
preconditions: Student Admin or Club Head designates students verified in the student registry.
action_or_input: Submit leadership assignment with valid student identifiers.
expected_result: System accepts leadership assignment.

purpose: Verify prohibited outcome of BR-GYM-001 when coordinator or co-coordinator is not a valid student.
preconditions: Selected user ID does not exist in student registry.
action_or_input: Submit leadership assignment with invalid student identifier.
expected_result: System stops and rejects operation with student validation error.

purpose: Verify permitted outcome of BR-GYM-002 when Club Faculty Councillor references a valid faculty member.
preconditions: Selected faculty ID exists in faculty registry.
action_or_input: Submit club creation or event booking with valid faculty councillor reference.
expected_result: System accepts faculty councillor assignment.

purpose: Verify prohibited outcome of BR-GYM-002 when Club Faculty Councillor is invalid.
preconditions: Selected user ID is not a faculty member.
action_or_input: Submit club creation or event booking with invalid faculty councillor reference.
expected_result: System stops and rejects operation with faculty validation error.

purpose: Verify permitted outcome of BR-GYM-003 when club category is Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Create club with category set to 'Technical', 'Sports', or 'Cultural'.
expected_result: System accepts allowed category value.

purpose: Verify prohibited outcome of BR-GYM-003 when club category is outside allowed values.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Create club with category='Social'.
expected_result: System rejects club creation with category constraint violation error.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-004 outcome where new club creation results in 'open' status.
preconditions: Valid club details provided by Student Admin.
action_or_input: Execute club creation.
expected_result: Club is saved with status='open'.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-004 outcome where Student Admin approval changes open club to confirmed.
preconditions: Club exists with status='open'; Student Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Student Admin executes approve action on open club.
expected_result: Club status transitions to 'confirmed'.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-004 stated exception where a non-open club cannot undergo approval and no rejection transition exists.
preconditions: Club already has status='confirmed'.
action_or_input: Student Admin attempts to approve the already confirmed club.
expected_result: System rejects the transition; club status remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-005 permitted threshold side where booking start time is earlier than end time.
preconditions: Booking submitted with start_time='14:00' and end_time='15:30'.
action_or_input: Validate booking time range.
expected_result: Validation passes; start_time < end_time accepted.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-005 prohibited threshold side where booking start time is equal to or later than end time.
preconditions: Booking submitted with start_time='16:00' and end_time='16:00' (or start_time='17:00' and end_time='16:00').
action_or_input: Validate booking time range.
expected_result: Validation fails; booking rejected.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-006 permitted outcome when session or event does not overlap any existing booking in same venue and date.
preconditions: Session in Venue-1 on date D from 10:00 to 12:00.
action_or_input: Submit event in Venue-1 on date D from 12:00 to 14:00.
expected_result: No conflict detected; booking is permitted.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-006 prohibited outcome rejecting session-session, event-event, and cross-type session-event overlap in same venue and date.
preconditions: Session in Venue-1 on date D from 10:00 to 12:00.
action_or_input: Submit event in Venue-1 on date D from 11:00 to 13:00.
expected_result: System rejects booking due to cross-type venue overlap.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-007 permitted outcome allowing student membership application to a confirmed club.
preconditions: Club exists with status='confirmed'.
action_or_input: Student submits membership application to the confirmed club.
expected_result: Application submission is permitted.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-007 prohibited outcome rejecting membership application to an unconfirmed (open) club.
preconditions: Club exists with status='open'.
action_or_input: Student attempts to apply for membership in the open club.
expected_result: System rejects application with error indicating club must be confirmed.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-008 permitted outcome allowing a student to apply to multiple different clubs.
preconditions: Student already holds an application/membership in Club A.
action_or_input: Student submits membership application to Club B (different club).
expected_result: Application is not blocked by existence of application in Club A; submission succeeds.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-009 prohibited outcome rejecting duplicate membership application to the same club.
preconditions: Student already has an application submitted for Club A.
action_or_input: Student submits another application to Club A.
expected_result: System rejects duplicate application; existing membership state remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-010 permitted outcome authorizing applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator for Club Head operations.
preconditions: Authenticated user is coordinator or co-coordinator of Club A.
action_or_input: User initiates Club Head operation (e.g., booking, membership approval, budget request) for Club A.
expected_result: Operation is authorized and proceeds.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-010 prohibited outcome refusing Club Head operations when user is not coordinator/co-coordinator of that club.
preconditions: Authenticated user is a student but not coordinator/co-coordinator of Club A.
action_or_input: User attempts Club Head operation on Club A.
expected_result: System denies operation with authorization failure.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-011 permitted outcome changing open application to confirmed and retaining optional remarks upon approval.
preconditions: Open membership application exists for Club A; Club Head submits approval with remarks='Accepted'.
action_or_input: Execute membership approval.
expected_result: Application status set to 'confirmed' and remarks are persisted.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-012 permitted threshold side accepting voting poll with at least two choices.
preconditions: Club Head creates poll with choices=['Option 1', 'Option 2'].
action_or_input: Validate choice count on poll creation.
expected_result: Validation succeeds; poll created.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-012 prohibited threshold side rejecting voting poll with fewer than two choices.
preconditions: Club Head creates poll with choices=['Single Choice'].
action_or_input: Validate choice count on poll creation.
expected_result: Validation fails; poll creation rejected.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-013 permitted outcome addressing poll notification and access only to selected batch and branch groups.
preconditions: Poll configured with target_batch='2024', target_branch='CSE'.
action_or_input: Determine intended audience for poll.
expected_result: Only students belonging to 2024 batch and CSE branch are included in audience.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-013 stated exception/variation where branch selection represents all branches for selected batch.
preconditions: Poll configured with target_batch='2024', target_branch='ALL'.
action_or_input: Determine intended audience for poll.
expected_result: Audience encompasses all students of batch 2024 across all branches.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-014 permitted outcome allowing participation when poll is active/unexpired and student is in target audience.
preconditions: Poll expiry date is in future; student is in target group.
action_or_input: Student requests poll access / vote submission.
expected_result: Participation permitted.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-014 prohibited outcome rejecting participation when poll is expired or student is not in target audience.
preconditions: Poll expiry date is in the past (expired poll).
action_or_input: Student attempts to cast vote in expired poll.
expected_result: System rejects vote with poll inactive/expired error.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-015 permitted outcome allowing student's first vote in a poll and updating tally.
preconditions: Eligible student has not yet voted in active poll.
action_or_input: Student casts vote for Choice 1.
expected_result: Vote accepted; tally updated; student recorded as voted.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-015 prohibited outcome rejecting second vote by same student in same poll.
preconditions: Student has already cast a vote in the poll.
action_or_input: Student attempts to cast another vote in the same poll.
expected_result: System rejects second vote; poll tally unchanged.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-016 permitted outcome ensuring superseded leadership designations no longer remain current after leadership change.
preconditions: Club leaders changed from student_01/02 to student_03/04.
action_or_input: Check active current leadership for club.
expected_result: Only student_03/04 have current leadership; student_01/02 are retired/removed from current leadership.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-017 permitted threshold side accepting budget amount zero or greater.
preconditions: Club Head submits budget request with amount='0.00' (or '100.00').
action_or_input: Validate budget amount.
expected_result: Amount is non-negative; validation succeeds.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-017 prohibited threshold side rejecting budget amount less than zero.
preconditions: Club Head submits budget request with amount='-0.01'.
action_or_input: Validate budget amount.
expected_result: Validation fails; request rejected with negative amount error.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-018 permitted outcome accepting budget request with supporting file included.
preconditions: Budget request contains valid supporting file.
action_or_input: Validate supporting file presence.
expected_result: Validation passes; file accepted.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-018 prohibited outcome rejecting budget request when supporting file is missing.
preconditions: Budget request submitted with no supporting file.
action_or_input: Validate supporting file presence.
expected_result: Validation fails; request rejected with missing file error.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-019 permitted outcome accepting event report with report/details file included.
preconditions: Event report contains valid report file.
action_or_input: Validate report file presence.
expected_result: Validation passes; report submission proceeds.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-019 prohibited outcome rejecting event report when report/details file is missing.
preconditions: Event report submitted with no report file.
action_or_input: Validate report file presence.
expected_result: Validation fails; report submission rejected.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-020 permitted outcome accepting booking with a configured Gymkhana venue.
preconditions: 'Hall-1' is an active configured venue in Gymkhana system.
action_or_input: Submit booking using venue='Hall-1'.
expected_result: Venue validation succeeds; booking proceeds.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-020 prohibited outcome rejecting booking with unconfigured venue.
preconditions: 'OffCampus-Cafe' is not a configured Gymkhana venue.
action_or_input: Submit booking using venue='OffCampus-Cafe'.
expected_result: Venue validation fails; booking rejected.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-021 permitted outcome allowing Club Faculty Councillor to review reports for assigned club.
preconditions: Authenticated user is assigned Club Faculty Councillor for Club A.
action_or_input: User accesses submitted reports of Club A.
expected_result: Access granted; reports displayed.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-021 prohibited outcome denying report review when faculty user is not assigned to that club.
preconditions: Authenticated faculty user is NOT assigned Club Faculty Councillor for Club A.
action_or_input: User attempts to access submitted reports of Club A.
expected_result: Access denied; no report information exposed.
